title: Share state with context
hints: In ThemeProvider: const [theme, setTheme] = useState("light"); and return <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, toggleTheme }}>{children}</ThemeContext.Provider>
useTheme: const context = useContext(ThemeContext); throw if it is null, otherwise return it.
ThemeButton and ThemedBox call useTheme() to read the shared value.
className={`box ${theme}`} builds the two class names.
